values.meaning: Reduced Damage per Mine (subsequent mine hits)
values.binNote: Wiki value is derived: DamagePerMine and APRatioPerMine each multiplied by SubsequentMineDamageMod=0.4; no direct bin calculation named ReducedDamage besides a tooltip-only reference.
Bin stores the slow as negative values [-0.1 to -0.5] (a movement speed modifier), the wiki states the magnitude as a positive percentage; same numbers, sign convention differs.

mechanics.claim: Each mine explodes on contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing damage and slowing.
mechanics.quote: Each mine within the area explodes upon contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: An enemy takes only 40% damage from mines after the first one hits it.
mechanics.quote: An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.

mechanics.claim: Mines do not explode from player-generated terrain (e.g. Anivia wall).
mechanics.quote: Mines will not explode upon contact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only one mine detonation's effects, not the whole field.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the effects of a single detonation.
